New Laws of the Republic of Liberia:

Prohibitions:

  1. Killing people isn't allowed. If you kill someone and are proven guilty in a trial, you shall be put to death by a state-appointed executioner. Killing a guilty party as a state-appointed executioner or as self-defence is permissible.

  2. Stealing isn't allowed. If you steal from someone and are proven guilty in a trial, you shall be put to work by the state in an internment facility.

  3. Trespassing isn't allowed. If you trespass and are proven guilty in a trial, you shall be put to work by the state in an internment facility.
